transactions.officeLocation: LTO District Office - Quezon City East
transactions.nextAction: Visit the LTO office with a valid ID to claim your Certificate of Registration and stickers.
notes: Bring the original Official Receipt for verification.
Claiming hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays.
The registered owner or an authorized representative with an SPA may claim.

transactions.nextAction: No action needed right now. Please wait for the next status update or check again in 2-3 business days.
notes: Transfer of ownership typically takes 5-7 business days.
You will be notified when documents are ready for release.
Ensure the Deed of Sale and clearance documents remain valid.

timeline.title: Application Received
timeline.description: Transfer of ownership request submitted with supporting documents.

timeline.title: Under Processing

transactions.nextAction: Complete the required medical certificate submission to continue processing your license renewal.
notes: A valid medical certificate from an LTO-accredited clinic is required.
Your transaction will resume once the missing requirement is submitted.
Please submit within 15 days to avoid cancellation.

timeline.title: Placed On Hold

transactions.nextAction: No further action needed. Your registration has been completed and documents released.
notes: Keep your Certificate of Registration and Official Receipt in the vehicle at all times.
Your next renewal will be based on the plate number ending digit schedule.
Report any discrepancies within 30 days of release.
